Will serve as the Program Manager for the Organic Ground Entry Point contract and other space-ground communication efforts.

Act as the responsible authority for the end-to-end execution, integration, delivery, and demonstration of space capabilities, such as satellites and ground systems, ensuring programs meet cost, schedule, and performance requirements. MDSEA is the critical ground command control system enabling MDA's space operations.
You may qualify at the NH 04 Broadband Level, if you fulfill the following qualifications: A.

One year of specialized experience equivalent to the NH-03/GS-13 grade level in the Federal service as listed below and must meet 2 of the 3 specialized experience listed below to be qualified: Executing research and development of Acquisition systems or Major Capabilities Acquisition pathways for delivery of space capabilities.

Utilizing of acquisition authorities such as Other Transactions. Managing and integrating space and associated ground and communication systems.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

You will serve as a/an Program Manager and be responsible for the planning, organization, execution, and coordination of assigned acquisition program(s), in accordance with approved charters and applicable policies and procedures.

The incumbent: contributes to the accomplishment of the mission, goals, and objectives by strategic direction and effective implementation of the objectives of assigned acquisition program(s); supports the planning and development of acquisition efforts, business, and organizational administrative operations; and provides direction on a wide range of program issues essential to the efficient operation.

Being a Coast Guard civilian makes you a valuable member of the Coast Guard team. Typical work assignments include: Developing, managing, and documenting short and long-range, acquisition planning activities that include multi-year work plans.

Planning and initiating a comprehensive evaluation system for the review and analysis of proposed costs, program development, and performance. Serving as the principal advisor on all project/program activities.

Monitoring the execution of the budget with many different sources and types of funding, such as direct multi-year appropriations and transfers of funds to and from other agencies. Expected to work towards obtaining and maintaining Federal Acquisition Contracting Certification FAC-C Level III.
To qualify at the GS-14 grade level, your resume must demonstrate at least one (1) full year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the GS-13 grade level in the federal or private sector.

Specialized experience is experience that has equipped you with the ability, skill, and knowledge to successfully perform the duties of this position and is typically in or related to this line of work. Examples of specialized experience include performing the following types of tasks on a regular basis.

NOTE: All experience statements (i.e., duties, specialized experience, or occupational assessment questionnaire) copied from this announcement and pasted into your resume will not be considered as a demonstration of your qualifications for this position.

Specialized experience may include the following: Develops, manages, and documents short and long-range, acquisition planning activities that include multi-year work plans.

Develops detailed plans, tasks, milestone dates and schedules to ensure proper sequencing of events and tracking of processes and costs throughout the lifecycle of the programs/projects; establishes program objectives and units of measure for determining when objectives have been met.

Provides analysis and development of appropriate cost-sharing mechanisms, full cost methodologies, and Earned Value Management System (EVMS) data; and develops procedures and systems for establishing, operating, and assessing the effectiveness of administrative control systems, such as those designed to prevent waste, loss, unauthorized use, or misappropriation of assets.

Oversees the analysis of effectiveness; prepares periodic status reports marking cost, schedule, and performance; and provides input to periodic government program reviews and contract baseline reviews. NOTE: Education cannot be substituted for experience at this grade level.

National Service Experience (i.e., volunteer experience): Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Develops and evaluates flight operations programs for organizations which utilize the newest, most complex aircraft systems, and equipment.

The APM is responsible for the oversight of flight operations involving large fleets (usually 30 or more) of turbine powered aircraft engaged in large-scale passenger and/or freight service for nationally and internationally prominent carriers.

Assignments at this level are of significant scope and complexity and the organizations monitored are traditionally major operators in the industry. Develops a work program to ensure periodic surveillance of designated pilot and flight engineer examiners, pilot and flight engineer check airmen, and company training programs.

Assures the assigned air carrier conducts flight crew training and testing required by appropriate Title 14 of the Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR), FAA-approved training programs, and current testing standards. Oversees company check airmen and APDs.

Serves as the technical advisor to the Principal Operations Inspector (POI) on assigned areas of the company's training and testing programs. Coordinates technical instructions, policy orders, and procedures through the POI to assure uniformity of training and testing activities.

Responsible for conducting enforcement investigations and preparation of final reports and recommendations on disposition. Performs or supervises the emergency suspension of certificates or cancellation of operations specifications. Conducts or directs the reexamination of certificated airmen or recertification of an operator or agency.

Conducts investigations of public complaints, congressional inquiries, and aircraft incidents and accidents. Provides verbal and/or written technical assistance to legal counsel, testifies at court trials and formal hearings, and gives dispositions.

Coordinates with geographic inspectors for the accomplishment of non-routine air carrier surveillance. Recommends the designation of APDs and pilot examiners. Responsible for the conduct of flight tests, additional type ratings, and flight engineer certification; proficiency tests; initial qualification tests, and line-oriented flight training.

Assures standardization of check airmen and designated examiners and recommends to the POI any changes which are considered necessary. Monitors assigned areas of the flight crew training program and associated records to ensure compliance with pertinent 14 CFR, national and regional directives, and safe operating practices.

Monitors assigned air carrier ground and flight training. Attends certificate holder's company and safety meetings. Evaluates training programs to ensure they meet the requirements of 14 CFR. Approves or disapproves training programs including flight simulators, training devices, or other equipment used in these programs.

May require amendments to previously approved manuals to correct any conflict with regulatory requirements; eliminate unsafe practices; and/or improve the specificity of instruction.

Participates in the FAA flight program to maintain qualification and currency requirements applicable to operations inspectors, for the purpose of supporting the FAA in a variety of flight-related functions to include training and evaluation of designated pilot examiners.

Evaluates tasks contained in the FAA practical test standards and airman certification standards by participating as pilot-in-command or as a crewmember. The Inspector is required to maintain an FAA second class medical. Performs other duties as assigned.
General Requirements for All Positions: Not more than two separate incidents involving Federal aviation regulations violations in the last 5 years; Valid State driver's license; Fluency in the English language; No chemical dependencies or drug abuse that could interfere with job performance; and High school diploma or equivalent.

Medical Requirements for All Positions: Applicants must be physically able to perform the duties of the Aviation Safety Inspector position in a safe and efficient manner, and must meet all of the following requirements: Have good distant vision in each eye and be able to read printed materials the size of typewritten characters (glasses and contact lenses permitted) without strain; Have the ability to hear the conversational voice (hearing aid permitted); Not have any physical condition that would cause them to be a hazard to themselves or others or that would interfere with their ability to fly as passengers in a variety of aircraft.

In addition, applicants for positions that require participation in the operation of aircraft must: Possess a valid second-class medical certificate in accordance with Federal Aviation Agency (FAA) regulations; and Pass recurrent medical examinations as prescribed by the FAA.

Applicants not requiring valid second-class medical certificates who are tentatively selected will be required to: Provide documentation from a board-certified physician certifying that they meet the minimal medical requirements; or Individuals who do not meet the minimum medical requirements but who are otherwise qualified will receive an individualized assessment to determine whether they can perform the essential functions of the position.

When the predominant work involves air carrier operations, applicants for Aviation Safety Inspector (Operations) positions must meet all of the following requirements.

At least 1 year of pilot experience in multi-engine aircraft of more than 12,500 pounds maximum certificated takeoff weight; Not more than 2 flying accidents during the last 5 years in which the applicant's pilot error was involved; Professional flying skill as demonstrated in a simulator check to Airline Transport Pilot Standard.

Minimum 100 flight hours during the last 3 years; Airline Transport Pilot Certificate or Commercial Pilot Certificate with instrument airplane rating (Department of Navy positions require pilot experience as demonstrated by previous ATP level performance in large multi-engine airplanes and helicopters); Possession of a valid second-class FAA medical certificate (For positions within the Department of Navy, applicants must also be physically qualified to ride as an observer aboard squadron aircraft.

In addition, must also meet physical requirements to travel and lift heavy objects while performing mishap investigations); and Minimum 1,500 total flight hours. Note - Recency of specialized experience and the need for a valid second-class FAA medical certificate is waived for employees currently in the 1825 series.

To qualify for this position you must demonstrate in your application that you possess at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to FV-I, FG/GS-13 grade level. Specialized experience is experience that has equipped you with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform successfully the duties of the position.

Specialized experience includes: Provide guidance in the development of required operations manuals and record keeping systems; analyze reports to insure compliance with operations programs. Conduct enforcement investigations and preparation of final reports and recommendations on dispositions.

To assist in determining qualification requirements, applicants transferring between specialties at the same grade level are strongly encouraged to complete the appropriate Qualifications Assessment Tool (QAT) check sheet and upload it along with their resume.

Check sheets are contained in Order 3410.26, Flight Standards Service Air Carrier and General Aviation Qualifications Assessment Tool for AFS Aviation Safety Inspectors. This order is located at: https://employees.faa.gov/org/linebusiness/avs/offices/afs/tools/qat/. This Position may have oversight of multiple fleet types.

You will serve as an Environmental expert and will be responsible for leading and managing many aspects of the BRAC Environmental Program.
You will lead and manage the annual gathering of environmental requirements and supporting cost estimates in the NORM (the Normalization of Data) database.
You will provide oversight for the maintenance and operations to the NORM database hosted by NAVFAC's Information Technology Center.
You will provide management oversight for the numerous Knowledge-Based Corporate Reporting System (KBCRS) reports throughout the year to DoD that reflect program costs and milestones.
You will lead environmental programmatic initiatives, tiger teams and technical efforts across the PMO.
Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-13 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector performing duties such as: 1) leading coordination and negotiations with federal and state regulatory agencies (e.g., EPA, state environmental departments) on complex programmatic or funding issues; and preparing written products-including briefs, point papers, reports, and correspondence-to present and defend program decisions to senior DoD, DON, or Congressional stakeholders.2) Experience leading environmental program management for a complex federal environmental restoration or compliance program, including developing and validating cost estimates, tracking milestones (such as RIP and RC), and preparing programmatic reporting for senior leadership and Congress 3)Experience analyzing and resolving complex program-level challenges, including reconciling system-to-system financial execution data, addressing budget shortfalls, and developing strategic workarounds to ensure environmental cleanup milestones remain on schedule.4)Experience directing federal environmental financial reporting processes, including POM budget formulation, Environmental Liabilities (EL) reporting, and ensuring data integrity across national-level tracking systems (such as NORM and KBCRS) to meet federal audit-readiness standards.5)Experience interpreting and applying federal environmental laws, regulations, and policies (e.g., CERCLA, RCRA, NEPA, SARA) to guide, evaluate, and report on environmental restoration, compliance, or real property disposal programs at an enterprise level.

Additional qualification information can be found from the following Office of Personnel Management web site: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/#url=List-by-Occupational-Series Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

As a Project Coordinator, you’ll support projects from initiation through completion, learning how to manage timelines, budgets, and deliverables while ensuring quality standards are met. You’ll assist in driving workflows, help maintain clear communication across teams, and keep project details organized.

This role is perfect for someone who’s adaptable, eager to learn, and excited to build foundational project management skills in a collaborative environment. At Precision AQ, we will recognize your achievements and contributions. You will have learning and growth opportunities to realize your full potential.

Core Responsibilities Support day-to-day project activities on assigned accounts (timelines, status reports, hot sheets, project routing) with a collaborative mindset Collaborate with team members to maintain open communication and learn how to anticipate challenges and contribute to solutions Assist with Workfront tasks, including project setup, tracking and reporting while building familiarity with project setup (planned hours) and processes Supports programs totaling $1M-$2M .

Upon growth in role, may manage up to $1M-$1.5M with oversight. Note: Up to 50% of time may be spent on administrative support and duties though expectations can vary based on needs to be aligned upon with manager.

Support budget tracking and reporting, partnering with seasoned PM team members, Account and Finance to ensure accuracy and profitability.

Engage in mentorship and training opportunities to develop operational and cross departmental knowledge, strengthen collaboration skills, and grow as a project management professional Promote and adhere to Precision Medicine Group 's workplace values known as Precision Principles (Client Service, Purpose, Accountability, Mutual Respect and Collaboration) Project Coordination Assist in scheduling and facilitating internal status and project kickoff meetings Deliver proactive updates on timelines and resourcing, under guidance, while developing the ability to anticipate needs and contribute to solutions Learn and maintain familiarity with agency framework, clients, and regulatory processes Help navigate workflow challenges by collaborating with team members to maintain operational efficiency and accountability Encourage candid communication during project planning and execution, building collaboration and trust Learn how to identify, assess, and mitigate project risks by observing plans and proactive escalation of issues by seasoned PM team members.

About DMI DMI is a leading provider of digital services and technology solutions, headquartered in Tysons Corner, VA. With a focus on end-to-end managed IT services, including managed mobility, cloud, cybersecurity, network operations, and application development, DMI supports public sector agencies and commercial enterprises around the globe.

Recognized as a Top Workplace, DMI is committed to delivering secure, efﬁcient, and cost-effective solutions that drive measurable results.

Learn more at www.dminc.com About the Opportunity DMI , LLC is seeking a Project Manager to lead day-to-day contract delivery for the American Battle Monuments Commission's Microsoft Enterprise Support Services contract, overseeing all CLINs, quality control, and stakeholder reporting.

This role serves as the primary point of contact with the ABMC Contracting Officer and COR, ensuring that SLA commitments, deliverable schedules, and contract compliance obligations are met across a Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform environment.

The Project Manager works closely with all key personnel to maintain program velocity and governance integrity throughout the base year and option periods.

Duties and Responsibilities: Develop and deliver the Program Management Plan within 10 business days of contract award, establishing baselines for scope, schedule, risk, and deliverable ownership across all CLINs.

Produce and submit the Monthly Contract Status Report covering completed work by CLIN, hours used, schedule progress, open risks, deliverable status, ticket trends, service level results, and decision points requiring ABMC input. Notify the Contracting Officer and COR in writing when authorized hours or funding reaches 80% of the applicable ceiling.

Manage key personnel availability, providing written notification to the CO/COR within one business day if a key team member becomes unavailable, and submitting a qualified replacement candidate within five business days.

Coordinate CLIN 0001 transition activities, including access and dependency tracking, documentation gap assessment, risk register maintenance, and readiness reporting. Oversee the Quality Control Plan (QCP) and corrective action processes, issuing formal Corrective Action Plans when required by the PWS.

Manage CO-authorized work scope, ensuring no work is performed outside CO authorization and that no billable hours are charged for replacement personnel onboarding. Serve as primary liaison between ABMC leadership, the CO/COR, and the technical delivery team, facilitating escalation resolution and change control decisions.

Qualifications Education and Years of Experience: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.

An equivalent combination of education and eight or more years of directly relevant federal IT program management experience will be considered in lieu of the degree requirement. 7+ years of experience managing federal IT services contracts in a program or project management capacity, including direct client-facing responsibility with government Contracting Officers and CORs.

Required Skills & Certifications: Demonstrated experience managing Time and Materials and Firm-Fixed-Price CLINs concurrently, including invoice accuracy, ceiling tracking, and deliverable compliance. Proficiency with ITSM and project management platforms (ServiceNow or equivalent ticketing system, Azure DevOps or equivalent sprint tracking).

Experience producing Program Management Plans, Monthly Status Reports, and Corrective Action Plans as formal government deliverables. PMP certification (Project Management Professional). DMI recommended minimum. Strong working knowledge of GSA MAS IT Schedule contract administration requirements.

Preferred Skills & Certifications: ITIL 4 Foundation certification or higher. Experience supporting Microsoft 365 or Azure managed services programs in a federal civilian agency environment. Familiarity with change control board (CCB) processes and Section 508 acceptance procedures.

Prior experience managing contracts with multiple interdependent CLINs under a T&M ceiling structure. Background Requirements: Must possess or be eligible to obtain and complete a Public Trust background investigation and/or a Public Trust clearance. Citizenship Status Required: Must be a U.S.

Citizen Physical Requirements: None required for this position. Location: Remote, US Minimum Salary Rate $95,914.50 Median Salary Rate $105,186.00 Working at DMI DMI is a diverse, prosperous, and rewarding place to work.

Über uns
Die Agentur PHILIPP GmbH ist eine mehrfach ausgezeichnete Technologie- und KI-Umsetzungsberatung für den Mittelstand. Wir entwickeln und implementieren KI-Lösungen, die im Alltag unserer Kunden funktionieren: von KI-Telefonie und Automatisierung über intelligente Dokumentenverarbeitung bis zu individuellen KI-Kollegen.
Wir machen aus KI keine Theorie. Wir übernehmen Verantwortung dafür, dass Lösungen sauber umgesetzt, integriert, getestet und vom Kunden wirklich genutzt werden.
Dafür suchen wir einen Projektmanager, der Kundenprojekte souverän steuert und gleichzeitig unsere interne Delivery mit klaren Prioritäten, Strukturen und Verbindlichkeit voranbringt.
Aufgaben
Kundenprojekte sicher ins Ziel bringen
Du steuerst KI-Projekte vom Kick-off bis zur erfolgreichen Übergabe und Abnahme.
Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden und hältst alle Beteiligten verbindlich auf dem Laufenden.
Du übersetzt Anforderungen in klare Aufgabenpakete für unsere Entwicklungs- und KI-Teams.
Du planst Projektphasen, Timings, Verantwortlichkeiten und Abhängigkeiten.
Du führst Kunden- und Projekttermine strukturiert, dokumentierst Entscheidungen und sorgst dafür, dass vereinbarte Punkte umgesetzt werden.
Du erkennst Risiken, fehlende Informationen oder Entscheidungsblockaden früh und führst sie aktiv zur Lösung.
Du begleitest Tests, Integration, Abnahme und Übergabe. Fertig ist ein Projekt erst, wenn es beim Kunden sauber funktioniert.
Delivery und Teamsteuerung weiterentwickeln
Du koordinierst Kapazitäten und Prioritäten über mehrere Kundenprojekte hinweg.
Du sorgst gemeinsam mit den Teamleads dafür, dass die richtigen Themen zur richtigen Zeit bei den richtigen Leuten liegen.
Du etablierst und pflegst klare Projektstandards: Projektstart, Anforderungen, Verantwortlichkeiten, Status, Tests, Abnahme und Dokumentation.
Du führst regelmäßige Projektstatus ein und machst Fortschritt, Risiken und notwendige Entscheidungen transparent.
Du hilfst dabei, wiederkehrende Abläufe zu verbessern und aus Projekterfahrungen bessere Standards für die Zukunft zu machen.
Du arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführung, Operations, Teamleads und Entwicklung zusammen.
Qualifikation
Das bringst du mit
Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, idealerweise in Digital-, Software-, Automatisierungs- oder KI-Projekten.
Du kannst komplexe Themen verständlich strukturieren und unterschiedliche Beteiligte zusammenbringen.
Du bist stark in Kundenkommunikation und trittst verbindlich, klar und professionell auf.
Du arbeitest eigenständig, denkst voraus und wartest nicht darauf, dass Probleme größer werden.
Du kannst Prioritäten setzen, auch wenn mehrere Themen gleichzeitig laufen.
Du verstehst technische Zusammenhänge ausreichend gut, um mit Entwicklern, KI-Spezialisten und Kunden auf Augenhöhe zu arbeiten. Du musst nicht selbst programmieren.
Erfahrung mit Tools wie Notion, Jira, ClickUp, Asana oder ähnlichen Projektmanagement-Systemen ist ein Plus.
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, mindestens C1.
Du bist bereit, regelmäßig vor Ort in Dingolfing und bei Kunden zu arbeiten. Remote-Arbeit ist möglich, aber nicht als reine Remote-Stelle gedacht.
Technische Erfahrung und Verständnis
Du hast bereits digitale, Software-, Automatisierungs- oder KI-Projekte gesteuert und kennst typische technische Abhängigkeiten, Risiken und Entscheidungswege.
Du verstehst die Grundlagen moderner KI-Lösungen, etwa LLMs, RAG, KI-Telefonie, Automatisierungen, APIs, Datenflüsse und Systemintegrationen.
Du kannst Anforderungen mit Kunden fachlich sauber klären und so aufbereiten, dass Entwickler daraus umsetzbare Arbeitspakete machen können.
Du erkennst, wenn für eine Umsetzung Daten, Zugänge, Schnittstellen, Datenschutzfreigaben oder Entscheidungen fehlen.
Du kannst technische Statusstände, Aufwandsschätzungen und Risiken nachvollziehen und für Kunden verständlich übersetzen.
Idealerweise hast du selbst Erfahrung mit n8n, REST-APIs, CRM- oder ERP-Anbindungen, Docker, Cloud-Systemen, Datenbanken oder Softwareentwicklung. Du musst nicht selbst entwickeln, solltest technische Teams aber wirksam steuern können.

Direkte Verantwortung für relevante KI-Projekte ab Tag 1.
Reale Mittelstandskunden statt interner Konzernpolitik oder endloser Präsentationen.
Ein kleines, ambitioniertes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung, Operations und technischen Teamleads.
Die Möglichkeit, unsere Projektorganisation und Delivery-Standards aktiv mitzugestalten.
Remote-freundliche Arbeitsweise mit regelmäßiger Zusammenarbeit vor Ort.

Eine klare Entwicklungsperspektive in einem wachsenden KI-Unternehmen.
Unsere Haltung
Bei uns zählt nicht, ob etwas in einer Präsentation gut klingt. Es muss beim Kunden funktionieren und einen echten Unterschied machen.
Wirkung
Wir arbeiten nicht für Beschäftigung. Wir arbeiten für Ergebnisse, die für Kunden und ihr Unternehmen spürbar sind.
Durchziehen
Wir übernehmen Verantwortung und bleiben dran. Wenn es für den Projekterfolg nötig ist, gehen wir den entscheidenden Extra-Meter.
Verstehen
Wir hören genau zu, verstehen das Geschäft unserer Kunden und lösen nicht nur das technische, sondern das tatsächliche Problem.
Weiterdenken
Wir sehen mit, was als Nächstes gebraucht wird. Wir verbessern Abläufe, statt nur Aufgaben abzuarbeiten.
Besser werden
Wir haben einen hohen Anspruch an unsere Arbeit. Fehler nutzen wir, um daraus bessere Lösungen, bessere Zusammenarbeit und bessere Ergebnisse zu machen.

bswift is a leading benefits administration company that specializes in providing tailored solutions for our clients. Our mission is to simplify the complex world of employee benefits and deliver exceptional service to our clients. The Service Delivery Manager is directly responsible for helping bswift meet and exceed client expectations by supporting consumers on our best‑in‑class software and services. This role partners closely with internal teams and clients to implement, maintain, and optimize client benefit administration sites while ensuring high‑quality service delivery, timely issue resolution, and continuous process improvement.

Client Site Implementation and Maintenance
Manage and provide technical guidance through the implementation of new client websites.
Continually update client sites as requirements change, including benefit class matrices, requirements documents, rates, permissions, field options, site text, and open items from implementation question logs.
Test client sites for quality assurance and track, monitor, and drive resolution of identified issues.
Client Collaboration and Deliverables
Partner with bswift teams (product management, development, call center) to meet client deliverables.
Create, manage, and obtain client sign‑off on Benefits Class Matrices, Requirements, Rates, Permissions, and Implementation Question Logs.
Configure systems for annual benefit program changes and client acquisitions.
Execute non‑automated service delivery processes as required.
Research and resolve client inquiries related to system and process issues.
Train clients on system features and services through presentations and demonstrations.
System Testing and Functionality
Test new and existing system functionality to ensure accurate client system configuration.
Conduct technical and product demonstrations for new or changing plans, site text updates, and release functionality changes.
Client Issue Resolution and Communication
Respond to client questions and concerns regarding bswift products with prompt, research‑based solutions.
Triage client tickets and questions within 24 hours, maintaining ownership from initial contact through resolution.
Provide clear, professional, and proactive communication to clients throughout the issue resolution process.
Process Improvement and Team Collaboration
Drive continuous process improvements by maintaining a deep understanding of internal systems and workflows.
Lead and create agendas for client meetings, as needed.
Coach and mentor team members, sharing best practices, new ideas, and customer insights throughout all phases of the product life cycle.

Manage workflows for carrier and payroll feed setup and maintenance.
Support sales and marketing activities as required.
Lead special projects as assigned.
Develop and implement fulfillment procedures.

s.h: WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED (Required Education and Experience)
s.t:
Bachelor’s Degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
5+ years of direct client‑facing experience and/or associate or analyst experience.
2+ years of project management experience.
Experience working within benefits administration, including knowledge of benefit plans, eligibility rules, enrollment processes, and client benefit programs.
Hands‑on experience configuring a benefits administration platform, including plan setup, eligibility rules, rates, permissions, and overall site configuration.
Solid technical background with the ability to understand and configure complex systems.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, and basic functionality.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage technical and non‑technical audiences.
Exceptional analytical and problem‑solving skills with the ability to use data strategically.
Demonstrated ability to work in a fast‑paced, ambiguous environment while maintaining high‑quality outcomes.
High level of productivity, reliability, and attention to detail.
Passion for teamwork, client service, and achieving business results through problem‑solving.

Experience working in a professional services or client implementation environment.

*Tu veux la liberté du temporaire et la sécurité du fixe ? Depuis 30 ans, nous accompagnons des centaines d-entreprises dans les métiers techniques du bâtiment, de la construction et de l-industrie à travers la Suisse en leur proposant les meilleurs talents. On ne va toutefois pas te mentir, on est exigeant. Alors si tu es une personne motivée et hyper enthousiaste rejoins le clan pour le poste de Chef de projet contrôle d-accès et vidéosurveillance*
## **Ta mission :** ##
**Comprendre les besoins et concevoir des solutions adaptées**
Vous analysez les attentes et les contraintes des clients afin de proposer des solutions sur mesure en contrôle d-accès, vidéosurveillance et systèmes de sécurité électronique.
**Piloter les projets de bout en bout**
Vous assurez la gestion complète des projets, depuis l-étude technique jusqu-à la mise en service des installations. Vous planifiez les différentes étapes, coordonnez les ressources et veillez au bon déroulement des opérations.
**Coordonner les intervenants du projet**
Véritable chef d-orchestre, vous facilitez la communication entre les équipes techniques, les fournisseurs, les sous-traitants et les clients afin de garantir une exécution fluide et efficace.
**Garantir coûts, délais et qualité**
Vous suivez l-avancement des projets avec rigueur et veillez au respect des budgets, des délais et des standards de qualité tout au long du cycle de réalisation.
**Superviser les installations sur le terrain**
Présent sur le terrain, vous contrôlez la bonne exécution des travaux, vérifiez la conformité des installations et vous assurez du respect des normes et des spécifications techniques définies.
**Déployer des technologies de sécurité innovantes**
Vous participez à l-intégration de solutions avancées telles que les systèmes de vidéosurveillance IP (VMS), le contrôle d-accès, la biométrie et les technologies de sécurité de dernière génération.
**Être l-interlocuteur privilégié du client**
Vous accompagnez les clients tout au long du projet, en assurant un suivi régulier, des conseils adaptés et une communication claire, contribuant ainsi à leur satisfaction et à la réussite des projets
## **Maintenant si on parlait de toi ?** ##
**Une solide formation technique**
Vous êtes issu(e) d-une formation dans les domaines de l-électricité, de l-électronique, des télécommunications, de l-informatique ou d-un cursus technique équivalent. Cette base vous permet de maîtriser les enjeux liés aux systèmes de sûreté et de sécurité.
**Une expérience confirmée en gestion de projets**
Vous justifiez d-une expérience réussie dans le pilotage de projets de sécurité électronique, de contrôle d-accès, de vidéosurveillance ou d-infrastructures techniques. Vous maîtrisez l-ensemble du cycle de vie d-un projet, de la conception à la mise en service.
**Une bonne connaissance du marché suisse**
Une expérience en Suisse ou une excellente maîtrise des normes, réglementations et pratiques locales constitue un véritable atout pour évoluer efficacement dans la fonction.
**De solides compétences techniques**
Vous êtes à l-aise avec les systèmes de vidéosurveillance (CCTV), le contrôle d-accès, les réseaux IP, les solutions VMS ainsi que les technologies de sécurité électronique. Vous savez analyser les contraintes techniques et proposer des solutions adaptées aux besoins des clients.
**Un excellent sens de l-organisation**
Méthodique et autonome, vous savez gérer plusieurs projets simultanément, définir les priorités et anticiper les risques afin de garantir le respect des délais, des budgets et des objectifs fixés.
**Un relationnel qui fait la différence**
Grâce à votre aisance relationnelle et votre sens du service, vous développez des relations de confiance durables avec les clients, partenaires et équipes internes. Vous communiquez avec clarté et efficacité à tous les niveaux d-un projet.
**Une mobilité adaptée au poste**
Titulaire du permis de conduire, vous appréciez le terrain et êtes disposé(e) à vous déplacer sur différents sites afin d-assurer le suivi des projets et l-accompagnement des clients.
**Un profil orienté résultats**
Proactif(ve), engagé(e) et force de proposition, vous prenez des initiatives et apportez des solutions concrètes pour contribuer au succès des projets et à la satisfaction des clients
## Ton interlocuteur/trice : ##
Ton contact pour ce poste est Cédric. Il saura t-accompagner, te conseiller et t-apporter la réponse à toutes tes questions concernant le poste.
Ce job ne correspond pas tout à fait à ce que tu cherches mais nos valeurs te parlent ? N-hésite pas à nous adresser ta candidature spontanée !

To be acceptable, the program must: (1) lead to a bachelor's degree in a school of engineering with at least one program accredited by ABET; or (2) include differential and integral calculus and courses (more advanced than first-year physics and chemistry) in five of the following seven areas of engineering science or physics: (a) statics, dynamics; (b) strength of materials (stress-strain relationships); (c) fluid mechanics, hydraulics; (d) thermodynamics; (e) electrical fields and circuits; (f) nature and properties of materials (relating particle and aggregate structure to properties); and (g) any other comparable area of fundamental engineering science or physics, such as optics, heat transfer, soil mechanics, or electronics.

The adequacy of such background must be demonstrated by one of the following: Professional registration or licensure -- Current registration as an Engineer Intern (EI), Engineer in Training (EIT)1, or licensure as a Professional Engineer (PE) by any State, the District of Columbia, Guam, or Puerto Rico.

Absent other means of qualifying under this standard, those applicants who achieved such registration by means other than written test (e.g., State grandfather or eminence provisions) are eligible only for positions that are within or closely related to the specialty field of their registration.

For example, an applicant who attains registration through a State Board's eminence provision as a manufacturing engineer typically would be rated eligible only for manufacturing engineering positions.

Written Test -- Evidence of having successfully passed the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE)2 examination or any other written test required for professional registration by an engineering licensure board in the various States, the District of Columbia, Guam, and Puerto Rico.

Specified academic courses -- Successful completion of at least 60 semester hours of courses in the physical, mathematical, and engineering sciences and that included the courses specified in the basic requirements under paragraph A.

The courses must be fully acceptable toward meeting the requirements of an engineering program as described in paragraph A.

Related curriculum -- Successful completion of a curriculum leading to a bachelor's degree in an appropriate scientific field, e.g., engineering technology, physics, chemistry, architecture, computer science, mathematics, hydrology, or geology, may be accepted in lieu of a bachelor's degree in engineering, provided the applicant has had at least 1 year of professional engineering experience acquired under professional engineering supervision and guidance.

Ordinarily there should be either an established plan of intensive training to develop professional engineering competence, or several years of prior professional engineering-type experience, e.g., in interdisciplinary positions.

Experience evaluating the technical maturity, engineering feasibility, and operational failure risks of emerging technologies or multi-disciplinary industrial systems, and developing strategies to successfully mitigate those risks.

Experience serving as a technical authority or lead advisor to senior clean-energy, industrial, or technology executives on highly complex physical science or engineering challenges.

Experience conducting performance reviews, checking physical site progress, or auditing technical data to ensure that contractors, grantees, or project teams comply with safety codes, technical standards, financial budgets, and regulatory frameworks. Qui sommes\-nous ?
Alpenda est un acteur de référence de la construction en Suisse romande depuis plus de 100 ans.

Forte de près de 200 collaborateurs, l'entreprise accompagne ses clients dans leurs projets de construction et de rénovation grâce à une approche globale couvrant la conception, la planification, la réalisation et la modernisation des bâtiments, avec une attention particulière portée à la qualité, à l'innovation et à la durabilité.

Filiale suisse du groupe DEMATHIEU BARD, Alpenda poursuit le développement de projets d'envergure. Ce lien renforce les synergies et les expertises des deux entreprises tout en préservant l'identité, la proximité et l'ancrage local qui font la force d'Alpenda.

Vous rejoignez la Direction Exploitation, en charge du pilotage des chantiers de l'ensemble des projets d'Alpenda. Sa mission est de garantir un haut niveau d'exigence en matière de qualité, de sécurité, de respect de l'environnement, ainsi que de maîtrise des délais et des budgets.

Nos équipes spécialisées interviennent sur des projets variés, en construction neuve comme en rénovation, dans les secteurs résidentiel et fonctionnel.

Reconnus pour notre expertise dans la réalisation de projets haut de gamme, nous accordons une importance particulière à l'accompagnement de nos clients, à la transparence de nos échanges et à l'excellence de nos prestations. En tant que Chef de Projet, vous assurez la gestion technique et le bon déroulement du projet.

Vous veillez également à la bonne représentation de l’entreprise et êtes un véritable leader de terrain, reconnu pour votre polyvalence et votre capacité à fédérer les différents intervenants.
Chef de projet H/F

Vous organisez, encadrez et accompagnez les équipes affectées au projet
Vous assurez la planification générale et le pilotage des travaux dans le respect des objectifs fixés.
Vous participez aux séances de projet avec le Maître d’Ouvrage et assurez le suivi des décisions ainsi que de la documentation associée
Vous entretenez et développez les relations avec le Maître d’Ouvrage, les mandataires, les entreprises et les autorités
Vous analysez les appels d’offres, comparez les soumissions et pilotez le processus d’adjudication. Vous accompagnez les équipes dans les négociations avec les entreprises et les partenaires
Vous supervisez l’établissement des contrats, des avenants et des documents contractuels
Vous assurez le suivi financier du projet, notamment la gestion budgétaire, le contrôle des coûts, la validation des situations de paiement et l’établissement du décompte final
Pourquoi pas vous ?
Vous avez obtenu un diplôme d’architecte ETS, HES ou EPF, de dessinateur en bâtiment ou en génie civil, d’ingénieur du bâtiment ou un titre jugé équivalent ?
Vous avez bénéficié d’une formation dans la conduite de travaux ou la gestion de projet ?
Vous justifiez d’au minimum 5 ans d’expérience en tant que Chef de Projet, idéalement au sein d’une Entreprise Totale ou Générale ?
Vous bénéficiez d’une première expérience réussie en Suisse dans une fonction similaire ?
Vous possédez de solides connaissances techniques, financières, de planification et de contrôle qualité acquises au travers de vos expériences ?
Votre capacité à fédérer, coordonner et accompagner les équipes est reconnue ?

This paradox - an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence - is why we exist. Our solution is autonomy.
We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to.
